description: Changes a maintenance window or every occurrence of a repeating one. Fields left out keep their value; recurrence null makes it a single window. Changing the times or recurrence undoes skipped and moved occurrences. Free.

announce.description: Show the window on the status pages that show its monitor (every page of the workspace without a monitor), and tell their subscribers, one occurrence at a time.

message.description: What visitors are told about the maintenance.

monitor_id.description: The monitor under maintenance; leave out or null for every monitor.

name.description: What the maintenance is, such as Database upgrade.

recurrence.description: How the window repeats; `null` or left out for a single window. starts_at and ends_at are then the first occurrence, and every other one starts at the same time of day in time_zone, daylight saving time or not, and lasts as long.

count.description: How many occurrences there are, skipped ones included. Not with until.

frequency.description: Repeat every interval days, months or weeks.

interval.description: Every how many days, weeks or months.

month_day.description: Monthly: the day of the month; a shorter month takes its last day. By default the first occurrence's day.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the times of day follow. By default the workspace's (GET /account).

until.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD in time_zone, an occurrence may start on. Not with count.

week.description: Monthly on a weekday instead of a day: the first to fourth, or -1 for the last, of weekday in each month.

weekday.description: With week: the day of the week, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

weekdays.description: Weekly: the days, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). By default the first occurrence's day.

starts_at.description: When it starts, ISO 8601; the first occurrence of a repeating window.

suppress_alerts.description: false keeps the window on record without holding alerts back.

name: update_maintenance_window
title: Change a maintenance window
